description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: white marble column, small praying angel statue, basin of holy water, golden candelabra, white marble steps, small white fountain, pillar of soft golden light, holy stone tablet with sun symbol, small bush of white flowers, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
